You can directly upload the binary programs easytier-core and easytier-cli, or a compressed .zip archive. Uploading a new version will automatically overwrite the old one. Download link: github.com/EasyTier/EasyTier
The uploaded files will be saved in the /tmp folder. If a custom program path is specified, the program will be automatically moved to that path when started.
